name: Yuzu Mayuko
source:
Hobbies: Observing people
Likes: Friends, peace and order
Dislikes: Men

A very stubborn girl who feels bad if she can't have her way. She dislikes men and [url=/c54699]Seita[/url] is not an exception to that, however she does not feel threatened by him because he is the only man in the Department of Cultural Studies.
